name: trippy
description: Trippy — network diagnostic tool combining traceroute, ping, and path analysis. Supports JSON, CSV, Markdown, pretty text, and interactive TUI output modes.

install_guidance.note: Binary is `trip`. Also available via cargo, apt, dnf, pacman, and as .deb/.rpm packages from GitHub releases. The --unprivileged flag allows running without root on supported platforms.

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install trippy: brew install trippy or download from GitHub releases.

commands.description: Run traceroute and output JSON report (passthrough: trip <targets> -m json [-C N] [--unprivileged] [--protocol icmp|udp|tcp])

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install trippy: brew install trippy. On Linux, may need --unprivileged or sudo.

commands.description: Run traceroute and output a pretty text table (passthrough: trip <targets> -m pretty [-C N] [--unprivileged])

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install trippy: brew install trippy. On Linux, may need --unprivileged or sudo.

commands.description: Run traceroute and output CSV report (passthrough: trip <targets> -m csv [-C N] [--unprivileged])

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install trippy: brew install trippy. On Linux, may need --unprivileged or sudo.

commands.description: Passthrough to trip for any command not covered by specific resources (--mode tui, --mode stream, --mode dot, --mode markdown, --mode silent, etc.)
